caption: Sassi of Matera, Matera
composition: Cave dwellings cascading above the ravine · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks down from the belvedere as the Sassi of Matera cascade from the upper left toward the ravine. Warm lights glow from the cave dwellings against the pre-dawn blue, while the dark ravine opens on the right and a stone parapet anchors the lower left. The 06:32 light is that of first dawn, soft on the stone.
